root_cause.text: The NVMe driver fails to release the reference to an existing admin queue (`ctrl->admin_q`) before overwriting it with a newly allocated queue during a controller reset in `nvme_alloc_admin_tag_set()`, resulting in a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a check to release the existing queue using `blk_put_queue(ctrl->admin_q)` if `ctrl->admin_q` is already set, immediately before allocating a new one with `ctrl->admin_q = blk_mq_alloc_queue(set, &lim, NULL)`.
